architecture_contract.context_scope: one_cell_line_or_cell_context_per_fit; the official README says the method was not designed for multi-cell-type or bulk prediction

input_and_fit_contract.control_rule: replace_upstream_global_random_control_sampling_with_deterministic_fold_local_controls_matched_by_biological_replicate_and_valid_context; never sample controls across outer roles
input_and_fit_contract.external_graph_rule: do_not_run_the_automatic_pickle_download_or_loader; separately inventory, license, hash, and safely convert the GO prior before admission
input_and_fit_contract.feature_rule: freeze_gene_symbols_and_duplicates; every queried perturbation must resolve to exactly one measured_expression_feature_and_graph_node
input_and_fit_contract.normalization_status: UNRESOLVED; freeze the exact GSE281160 matrix layer and reproduce an upstream-compatible training scale inside each outer-training fold
input_and_fit_contract.preprocessing_rule: create the target_locus_guide_family_and_replicate split before DE genes, dropout genes, control construction, graph construction, or cache creation
input_and_fit_contract.split_rule: do_not_use_upstream_pickle_splits; provide an immutable project split and make every processed cache key include its SHA256
input_and_fit_contract.training_graph_rule: coexpression edges may use outer-training expression only; the pinned implementation requests set2conditions.train but its cache identity is insufficient without the project split hash

query_contract.reason: GSE281160 perturbs noncoding variant loci with CRISPRi guides. GEARS queries perturbed gene symbols, not variant loci or guide sequences. Mapping a locus to a gene would inject a new prior and would no longer be the registered held-target task.
query_contract.valid_future_use: gene_perturbation_response with exact target genes in the expression and graph vocabularies after every dataset, prior, adapter, and biological-unit gate passes

runtime_contract.completed_probe: SLURM job 21067574 passed a fixed-seed 8-gene synthetic GEARS_Model CPU forward/backward with exact repeat, finite gradients, runtime network blocked, no external GO graph, no pickle/checkpoint, and no biological data

safe_loading_contract.finding: PertData.__init__ downloads and pickle.loads a GO mapping; the default perturbation-gene path also downloads and pickle.loads an essential-gene list. Model save/load also uses pickle and unrestricted torch.load.
safe_loading_contract.project_action: no upstream pickle or Torch artifact may be deserialized; convert approved immutable artifacts in a restricted inspection job and load only validated state dictionaries and JSON metadata

source_evidence: Pinned official repository and Nature Biotechnology paper were inspected on 2026-08-22. The existing cell-gears 0.1.2 environment passed a network-blocked synthetic core forward/backward fixture on CPU SLURM job 21067574 on 2026-08-24. No upstream weight, biological data, external GO artifact, pickle, or checkpoint was loaded.
